algebra.expression: T_small o C_gray o N_(every4,24) o Q_scaffold (Halo(t=112))
algebra.convention: Operators compose right to left; each selection acts on the current SVG result. These are discrete geometric operators, not identities in a vector space.

operators.Q_scaffold: Set fill and stroke of dot/outline scaffolding to none; this is visual suppression, not deletion.
operators.N: Sample selected circles, spline the samples and replace each source circle with normal-oriented line segments.
operators.C_gray: Luminance-to-neutral palette after replacement makes both inherited and new marks monochrome.
operators.T_small: A small affine shear preserves the global cellular arrangement.

algebra.orderMatters: Selection, conversion and spline replacement change the domain available to subsequent operators. Color before geometry is inherited by new marks; color after geometry enumerates the newly created marks.
